method: Reconstructed the exact year totals and choices from the dated guide and reread the individual thesis, methods, thematic and literature-study entries before reviewing the frozen UCR schedules, comparison rows and audience fields.
findings: The dated programme lists 60 EC in each year. The first year also has the zero-credit Dutch writing diagnostic. Two approved 12 EC thematic courses complete year two alongside 36 compulsory credits. Conflict and Gender and Sexuality are the first two in official list order with the specified second-semester offerings, and both require 60 EC. Year three keeps 30 free EC and illustrates the first listed 9 EC deepening module, literature study. That course and philosophy require 90 EC. The individual thesis requires 108 EC in the programme and at least 6 EC each of advanced qualitative and quantitative methods. The current mandatory methods courses satisfy those conditions after the first two years.

The active workbook supports three distinct responses: broad applied social research, inequality and institutions, and health in social and behavioural context. The dated Health and Global Health, Gender and Care courses independently support the third response. Policy analysis, data modelling and population-health evidence are a better fit in that option than a separate biomedical sequence. The three pairs differ by 45, 45 and 82.5 EC in each direction.

The new policy practicum alignment covers concrete stages of policymaking, while the comparator adds a group investigation. Research synthesis directly overlaps with the selected literature study, with quantitative meta-analysis distinct from interdisciplinary synthesis. Gender history and Peace & Conflict each have direct, bounded overlap with the illustrated thematic choices. Dedicated anthropology and urban geography and the integration practica remain important differences. Optional UCR research is alongside the thesis outside scheduled credits.

The normal view selects the three revised concepts, 21 credited comparator components, 36 UCR course titles and descriptions and 11 stable progression and choice notes. The zero-credit diagnostic is represented in the skills note, and the primary and supporting links lead to official evidence.
